baseline_artifact_policy: Reuse exact completed EXP10RERUN runs for the same seeds and matching configuration; copy artifacts into this isolated workspace without modifying source runs.
mask_correct_runs: Train fresh in this isolated workspace after preflight passes.
initialization_policy: Reset Python, NumPy, and Torch seeds to the run seed before constructing each model; verify mapped baseline/mask-correct trainable tensors are identical at initialization.
test_evaluation_policy: Do not evaluate canonical test split until all four mask-correct runs complete and all best checkpoints/configurations are fixed. Validation loss alone selects checkpoints.
